title: AI can be wrong
intro: AI can sound very sure of itself and still be wrong. Sometimes it even makes up facts that sound real.
That happens because it guesses the most likely words, not because it checked the facts.
So when something matters, like health, safety or a school test, check with a trusted adult or a reliable source.

game.prompt: What do you do with each AI answer?

items.text: AI says a mushroom you found in the park is safe to eat
items.explain: Never eat a mushroom just because AI said so. Wild mushrooms can be dangerous, so ask an adult.

items.text: AI suggests a funny name for your drawing
items.explain: A name for a drawing can't hurt anyone. Have fun!

items.text: AI gives you the date of a famous event for a test
items.explain: AI can mix up dates. Check in your schoolbook or with your teacher.

items.text: AI says how much medicine to take for a headache
items.explain: Only a parent or a doctor decides about medicine.

items.text: AI writes a silly poem about your cat
items.explain: A silly poem is just for fun, so mistakes don't matter.

items.text: AI says a website is safe for typing your password
items.explain: AI can be wrong about safety. Ask a parent before typing a password anywhere.

quiz.question: AI sounds very sure about an answer. Does that mean it's right?
options: Not necessarily, it can still be wrong
Only if it uses long words
quiz.explain: AI can sound sure and still be wrong.

quiz.question: Why does AI sometimes make up facts?
options: It guesses likely words instead of checking facts
quiz.explain: AI predicts words that sound right. It doesn't always check whether they're true.

quiz.question: AI gives you advice about your health. What do you do?
options: Do what it says right away
Ask a parent or a doctor
quiz.explain: Health questions go to a parent or a doctor, not to AI alone.

summary: AI can sound sure and still be wrong. For fun things that's fine; for health, safety or school facts, check with a trusted adult or a reliable source.
